implementation.name: original-v1-neuron-to-machine
implementation.scope: Two examples, two inputs and outputs, active two-by-two corner of source four-by-four PE array; no bias or activation.
implementation.question: How does batching reuse the same weights?

purpose: Keep weights resident while distinct input rows update output accumulators and commit their own Z rows.
storyboard: Show X/W/Z as the same batched operation.
Stage one tile and stream the first row through reduction.
Commit row one, stream row two with unchanged weights, then commit row two.
